Chapter 406: Chapter 16 Eighth Layer (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan had communicated with the eldest senior brother multiple times, which appeared caring, but in fact, it was also for his own sake.

After all, at present, Lin Yuan was only a step away from the Eighth Layer, and his Mental Will Index had soared to over nine thousand eight hundred after condensing the Magic Jade Mark.

The ten thousand point threshold was within reach.

As long as his Mental Will Index reached ten thousand points, Lin Yuan would be able to step directly into the Eighth Layer.

“At that time, my true self will go to the Star Domain to sit in command, the Yin God will remain on the Battlefields of Different Races to comprehend the Eternal Spatial Rift, and the Yang Spirit will stay on the Chikun Main Star, leaving behind a drop of essence blood…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

...

The true self with the strongest power would be sweeping all combat power in the Star Domain.

Even if an accident occurred and the true self fell, the essence blood left on the Chikun Main Star could rapidly grow and “return” in the most perfect form with the help of the divine skill “Blood Rebirth.”

There would be no need to resort to the measures derived from the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit for generating a physical body.

Of course, to minimize losses, the true self that was going to sit in command at the Star Domain definitely couldn’t carry any treasures, otherwise, if it died and lost the treasures, Lin Yuan would still feel pained.

A physical body could be reborn, but treasures could not be brought back.

“Maybe I’m overthinking it.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and slightly shook his head.

According to the Human Civilization Alliance’s data, the mortality rate for newly promoted Eighth Rank Evolvers going to sit in command in the Fringe Starfield is very low.

That’s the case for ordinary Eighth Rank Evolvers,

let alone Lin Yuan, who could crush most of the Eighth Layer when he was only at the Seventh Rank. When he gets promoted to the Eighth Rank, his combat power will once again undergo a great transformation,

by which time he could probably stand shoulder to shoulder with those at the pinnacle of the Eighth Layer.

…

Virtual World.

Inside a bar.

This bar was open only to Evolvers above the Seventh Rank, forming a high-ranking Evolver communication venue in human civilization.

Lin Yuan was sitting in a corner, casually chatting with Gao Wufeng.

Some time ago, Gao Wufeng, practicing the Evolution Path derived from that body part, almost lost himself in madness, but was timely suppressed by his teacher, the Nine Swords Star Master, and has barely recovered recently.

“I finally understand why you, Shisan, did not cultivate the Evolution Path within that body part back then, it turns out you were pursuing a second method…”

Gao Wufeng had an epiphany.

Not long ago, the Goddess of Wisdom once again announced that comprehending that body part involved not only direct cultivation but also the deduction of a certain number of Evolution Paths as another way.

The Goddess of Wisdom specifically emphasized that this method was extremely difficult, which is why it wasn’t announced immediately but was tested with a selection of talented Evolvers first.

Now that it was confirmed there were no problems, it was finally announced to the public.

“Hahaha…”

Lin Yuan shook his head and smiled.

The Goddess of Wisdom was indeed considerate. This way, it happened to conceal Lin Yuan’s identity.

“I understand, you cannot divulge such a secret to outsiders, Shisan…” Gao Wufeng immediately expressed his understanding.

“But this method is too outrageous, comprehending a certain number of Evolution Paths? Under that kind of Spirit Will Pressure, it’s hard enough just to maintain sanity, let alone deduce one Evolution Path after another?”

Gao Wufeng shook his head, his tone revealing helplessness.

Indeed.

This method is extremely safe.

At least one’s Spirit Will would not be affected by incorrect Evolution Paths.

But realistically, it’s almost impossible to achieve… If you don’t cultivate the deduced Evolution Paths, you will continue to be suppressed by the Psychic Will Pressure.

This kind of pressure isn’t from weak to strong but is based on the strength of the Evolver’s Spirit Will.

Even if your Mental Will Index reached twenty thousand points, under that Spirit Will Pressure, you would quickly reach your limit.

And then, it all depends on your endurance.

Before comprehending that body part, Lin Yuan’s Mental Will Index was just over seven thousand points, but after a few years of comprehending, it was nearly ten thousand points.

Under the pressure of the seemingly inexhaustible Spirit Will, it’s a kind of tempering for one’s own Spirit Will.

“I haven’t deduced too many myself,”

Lin Yuan nodded, the Evolution Paths contained within that body part were endless in his eyes, and he had only thoroughly comprehended just over three thousand, which was merely a drop in the ocean.

“There you go being modest again, Shisan…”

Gao Wufeng looked at Lin Yuan with a touch of helplessness.

At the same time, he wondered to himself, how many paths? To be able to say this, at the very least, it meant Shisan had deduced at least five or six Evolution Paths, perhaps even close to ten?

…

After chatting casually with Gao Wufeng for a while,

Lin Yuan returned to the virtual world of comprehending that body part.

“The Goddess of Wisdom actually revealed the second method?” Lin Yuan pondered internally.

After a brief thought, Lin Yuan understood again—what would it matter even if the method was made public?

As long as it wasn’t disclosed how many Evolution Paths need to be comprehended to reach the target, it would be meaningless to let the Different Species know.

Sometimes, the goal is vital. If one does not know how many evolution paths they have truly comprehended, those alien strong ones would basically find it impossible to persist.

After all, the psychic will pressure from that segment of the body is a form of extreme torture. In a suboptimal state, the speed of enlightenment declines greatly.

Lin Yuan stumbled into it by accident, never intending to comprehend the Supreme Evolution Path but merely aiming to temper his spirit will.

Moreover, with the boost from Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he rapidly comprehended three thousand three hundred and thirty-three types, and finally condensed the Magic Jade Mark, achieving an enlightenment of everything.

Others? They could hardly keep going.

…

“Continue to contemplate,”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and looked up at that segment of the body beneath the sky once more.

Even though Lin Yuan was now a regular member of the Magic Jade Tower, where there are regular members, there are core and even higher-level members.

If he continues to comprehend more evolution paths, could he possibly gain a promotion in his status within the Magic Jade Tower?

What’s most important is that contemplating the evolution paths within the body is hugely beneficial for Lin Yuan; he could integrate their essence into himself after analysis.

And he could also continue to enhance his own spirit will.

It was indeed killing three birds with one stone.

Naturally, Lin Yuan was unwilling to give up.

Even if not long after, Lin Yuan advanced to the Eighth Layer, he would not give up this place.

Just like that.

Lin Yuan submerged himself into contemplation once again.

One day, two days.

One month, two months.

A year went by in the blink of an eye.

Hum.

Under the endless psychic will pressure,

Lin Yuan’s will seemed to reach its limit and started to crumble from the outer regions.

“Hold on, hold on.”

Lin Yuan was still persevering.

Unaware of how much time had passed, as if breaking through certain shackles,

Lin Yuan’s spirit will began to transform. What was once nothing but an illusion now radiated a deep light, as tangible as reality.

“Phew.”

Lin Yuan exhaled softly.

That moment just now, he nearly couldn’t hold on.

Fortunately, he hadn’t given up in the end.

“My current spirit will…”

Lin Yuan sensed that his spirit will had definitely improved greatly compared to before, taking an important step from illusion to reality.

“Let’s see what my current Mental Will Index is.”

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World and rested in reality for half a day.

Then, in the most perfect state, he entered his personal space.

“Goddess of Wisdom, I request a measurement of my Mental Will Index,”

Lin Yuan directly connected with the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, without using any physical soul power, just by employing your own spirit consciousness, impact the surroundings…”

The solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came.

Lin Yuan did as instructed, his vast psychic will pressure sweeping through the area.

Distortions seemed to occur in the air.

A moment later,

The voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came again.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, after testing, your current Mental Will Index is roughly around eleven thousand two hundred…”

“Increased by so much?” Lin Yuan’s heart was exhilarated.

A Mental Will Index of ten thousand was the threshold, determining the successful passage through the Heart Demon Tribulation.

Similarly, after reaching ten thousand, the difficulty of improving the Mental Will Index spikes significantly.

For Lin Yuan to achieve a Mental Will Index over eleven thousand is unbelievable.

For a Seventh Rank Evolver to raise his Mental Will Index to such a level is unprecedented in the history of Human Civilization.

“Mental Will Index exceeding ten thousand.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and made a decision.

“Everything is ready, begin the breakthrough to the Eighth Layer directly.”
